description.en:
KNOWIN-X1 is a folding, dual-arm embodied robot designed around frequently repeated household tasks. The manufacturer combines manipulation, spoken interaction and home-monitoring functions in a platform intended to operate within real domestic surroundings.

Its software is built around KNOWIN's GLOW system, which links world generation, world modeling and behavior learning. The stated aim is to improve longer task sequences and adapt service to individual households through continued learning. The folding mechanical design and paired arms support the physical side of that approach. Public positioning focuses on a developing home-assistance platform; specific chores and autonomous performance depend on the deployed model and environment.
